name: York Street Interchange LiDAR Point Cloud (3D)
description: Airborne LiDAR point cloud of the York Street Interchange scheme in central Belfast (M2/M3/Westlink junction), surveyed 2012 by Fugro-BKS for DfI Roads. Delivered in a local site grid and georeferenced here to Irish Grid, then streamed in 3D as an OGC 3D-Tiles octree. Rendered with deck.gl interleaved into the map: tilt and zoom in and the individual scanned points load in place; zoom out and they unload. Level-of-detail streaming keeps performance bounded regardless of dataset size.
